prediction.description: Predict when the wood fire must be lit again so the buffer tank never runs dry. The model is deliberately simple: start with the defaults, then compare the 'observed power' and 'estimated power' attributes of the new sensors and adjust the building loss coefficient until they match.

data.weather_entity: Weather entity used for the forecast
data.buffer_threshold_entity: Entity giving the temperature the tank must stay above (the heating circuit flow setpoint is used when empty)
data.ignition_delay: Time from lighting the fire to the tank being charged (minutes)
data.relight_window_start: Earliest time the fire can be lit
data.relight_window_end: Latest time the fire can be lit
data.stratification_factor: Weight of the top probe in the tank average (0 to 1)
data.dhw_daily_energy: Domestic hot water drawn from the tank (kWh per day)
